verdict.rationale: Homebrew has no documented concept of automations with built-in versioning, review, or rollback. The Brewfile is a declarative state file that can be committed to a project repository, but the versioning and review would come from the user's git workflow, not from Homebrew itself. No rollback mechanism is documented, and a community user reports that rolling back bad updates was a huge pain and that they had to disable cleanup to keep old versions as a workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
